A boy learned to break the deadliest army formation before he was even born. Stay till the end, because what happened next still makes mothers cry.

As the story goes, Arjuna was telling his pregnant wife Subhadra how to enter the Chakravyuha, a spinning wheel of soldiers no one could escape. The baby in her womb was listening. But halfway through, Subhadra fell asleep.
So the baby learned how to get in, but not how to get out. Sixteen years later, that baby was Abhimanyu. On the thirteenth day of the war, he alone broke into the Chakravyuha.
Wait, could he get out? He fought seven great warriors at once, and when his sword broke, he fought with a chariot wheel. He never came out. But no one has ever forgotten him.
That's why mothers listen to stories of courage and God while they are pregnant. The child is already listening. Comment Abhimanyu, and send this to a mother-to-be.
